sections.label: OBU security design and advice
sections.summary: LTA consulted an inter-agency committee including the Cyber Security Agency, which advised that core charging transactions and ERP data be processed securely; OBUs are designed with security features superior to a mobile phone.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: LTA consulted an inter-agency committee including the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore, who advised that the core charging transactions and ERP data must be safely and securely processed with high assurance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The on-board units or OBUs, which is an integral part of the ERP system, have been designed to uphold the necessary protection for such purpose, and the security features are superior to that of a mobile phone.

sections.label: Dedicated OBU for payments
sections.summary: LTA concluded it is better to process payments through a dedicated and integrated OBU, similar to today's in-vehicle unit, due to failed transactions and inconveniences.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: There will bound to be numerous unintended failed transactions and inconveniences caused.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Hence, LTA concluded that it is better to process payments through a dedicated and integrated OBU, similar to today’s in-vehicle unit or IU.

sections.label: OBU pricing and installation
sections.summary: The first OBU is free for existing Singapore-registered vehicles; for new vehicles it is installed and part of the purchase cost, with pricing, warranty and installation details to be released later.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The first OBU will be free of charge for existing Singapore-registered vehicles.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For new vehicles, the OBU would already be installed in the vehicle and form part of the overall cost of purchasing a new vehicle, as is the case with the IUs today.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The pricing of OBU is still under consideration and LTA will release more details later including the warranty period of OBUs and information of the installation exercise.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In allocating the slots for installation, we will ensure that there are sufficient installation points and give motorists ample notice to make their booking.

sections.label: Core charging only through OBU
sections.summary: The core charging function can only be done through the OBU, not third-party apps or mobile phones, because of security, data security and reliability reasons.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: What we are doing is that the core charging function can only be done through the OBU, no third-party apps, not done through the mobile phone, simply because of security reasons and data security as well as reliability.

sections.label: Urgency for next-gen ERP
sections.summary: There is an urgency and need to implement the next-generation ERP, with a timeline announced starting next year for 18 months of installation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, there is an urgency, a need to implement the nexgen ERP.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have already announced the timeline, starting from next year, for 18 months to do the installation.

sections.label: OBU design change costs
sections.summary: LTA is contractually bound, so any significant changes to the OBU design at this stage will incur cost.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regards to changing the OBU design at this stage, well, the fact is as the Member had said, we are contractually bound, so, any significant changes to the design of the OBU, will of course incur cost.

sections.label: nexgen ERP implementation and tender
sections.summary: The speaker says implementation should be smooth, the system stabilised, and display units offered to motorists when possible, and asks about the 2016 tender award.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said, we want a smooth implementation of the nexgen ERP, let the system stabilise, we will look at this and then when it is possible, we will be able to offer it to the motorists and they can replace their display units.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: One supplementary question I would like to ask is basically, the tender was awarded in 2016 as we understand.

sections.label: First-of-its-kind international tender
sections.summary: The speaker says the project is first-of-its-kind with an international tender and no reference point, so time was taken to review tenders and proposals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said it is a first-of-its-kind project, it is an international tender and there is no reference point so we did take a bit of time to look through the various tenders and proposals before we awarded it.

sections.label: Inter-Ministry committee and OBU reviews
sections.summary: The speaker says an inter-Ministry committee was consulted and two independent reviews of the OBU security features were done, leading to the OBU integrated with the ERP backend.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have also got an inter-Ministry committee that we consulted as I have shared earlier.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And in fact, we also did two independent reviews on the features, the security features of the OBU.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: That is the reason why we have adopted what we have recently shared – that the OBU integrated with the ERP backend system and no third-party apps or use of mobile phone for the core charging functions.
